en.hubeali: H 14780 – Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassaan, from Ali Bin Abu Al-Nawaar, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said:
I said to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws. Which is that thing which makes the sun to be hotter than the moon?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created the sun from the light of the fire and clearness of the water, a layer from this and a layer from this until there were seven layers, then clothed it with a clothing from the fire. Then it became hotter than the moon’.

I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you, and the moon?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created the moon from the illumination of the light of the fire and clearness of the water, a layer from this and a layer from this until there were seven layers, then clothed it in a clothing of water, so the moon became colder than the sun’.
en.sarwar: 333. Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassaan, from Ali Bin Abu Al-Nawaar, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s.), ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.).

Which is that thing which makes the sun to be hotter than the moon?’ So he (a.s.) said: ‘Allah (azwj) Created the sun from the light of the fire and clearness of the water, a layer from this and a layer from this until there were seven layers, then clothed it with a clothing from the fire. Then it became hotter than the moon’.

I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you, and the moon?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘Allah (azwj) Created the moon from the illumination of the light of the fire and clearness of the water, a layer from this and a layer from this until there were seven layers, then clothed it in a clothing of water, so the moon became colder than the sun’.
